subject.title: [Bug]: Gateway startup fails after update to 2026.6.8 — ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for server-chat-DVXWYmKw.js (regression of #72042)

question: Should this stay in maintainer-owned live-repro triage until WSL2 npm global upgrade proof is captured, or should maintainers sponsor a source-level package-integrity repair without that live proof?
rationale: The issue has concrete crash evidence and source plausibility, but the tarballs contain the chunks and no merged fix currently proves the installed-state failure is gone.

options.title: Keep Live-Repro Gate
options.body: Keep the issue open with no-new-fix handling until a WSL2 global npm upgrade and Gateway restart reproduction identifies the destructive install/postinstall step.

options.title: Sponsor Package-Integrity Repair
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly own a targeted repair based on source and tarball evidence, accepting that the exact WSL2 installed-state path is not yet reproduced.

options.title: Fold Into Scanner PR Only
options.body: Route remaining attention to the open scanner PR, but this risks losing the broader installed-upgrade crash if scanner coverage is only a partial fix.

recommendation.title: Keep Live-Repro Gate
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open with no-new-fix handling until a WSL2 global npm upgrade and Gateway restart reproduction identifies the destructive install/postinstall step.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows direct work on packaged dist scan bounds and scanner dependency forms adjacent to the reported install-integrity failure.
